_comment: The feature guides on sheprd.org/features, in the order shown. Each id names its screencast, scripts/screencast/features/ID.json, whose narration is the page's transcript. Run website/tools/features.py after changing this file or a clip. `poster` (seconds) picks the still a page shows before playing; change it and run `features.py posters`.

features.headline:
Talk to your agents.
See their work.
features.dek: Claude, Codex, Gemini and more in a real chat beside the terminal. Switch agents any time; every read, edit and test run is a card you can open.
features.description: Run Claude, Codex, Gemini and other coding agents in native chats beside your terminal, switch between them, and follow each step.
how: Start a chat
Click the agent button next to the new tab button. It starts the agent you used last; hover it to pick another.
Pick your agent
The agent menu under the message box switches the chat to Claude, Codex, Gemini, Copilot, OpenCode, Kimi or Pi, whichever you have installed.
Follow every step
Each read, edit and command shows as a card with its files and output, so nothing happens out of sight.
features.keywords: ACP agent chat claude codex gemini copilot opencode kimi pi switch agent assistant conversation prompt tool calls

features.headline:
Read it
before it ships.
features.dek: Every file an agent touched, beside the code it replaces, with notes that go straight back to the agent.
features.description: Review an agent's changes file by file, leave notes on lines, and mark files viewed.
how: Open Review Changes
Search for it in the command palette. It lists every file with uncommitted changes, or everything since the base branch.
Note what should change
Click a line number, describe the change and add the note. Notes go to the workspace's agent.
Keep track
Mark each file viewed once it looks right, and hide viewed files to see what is left.
features.keywords: diff git code review notes comments uncommitted branch viewed

features.headline:
Everything,
one shortcut away.
features.dek: Workspaces, terminals, agents and every command in one list. Type a few letters, press Return.
features.description: Find any workspace, terminal, agent or command in Sheprd's command palette.
how: Open it
Press Command Shift P (Control Shift P on Linux and Windows).
Type and go
A few letters find a workspace, a terminal, an agent or a command. Return runs it.
Narrow it down
The chips at the top keep only navigation, commands, projects or notes.
features.keywords: search shortcut keyboard actions commands navigation quick open

features.headline:
Show your agent
which button you mean.
features.dek: Pin a note to a button in the live preview. The agent gets your request and the element it belongs to in one message.
features.description: Annotate a local browser preview, send the selected element to its agent, and see the page reload after the edit.
how: Ask for a preview
Have the agent open the local page with sheprd browser open. The preview opens beside the chat.
Pick the button
Choose Annotate and click a page element. Describe the change and choose Add note to pin it.
Send your feedback
Choose Send to agent. Sheprd includes the element and the note so the agent can find the exact button.
features.keywords: web page preview localhost annotate notes webview url

features.headline:
Make yourself
at home.
features.dek: Dark, light, or somewhere in between. Preview a theme across the whole window before you make it yours.
features.description: See your workspace change as you browse themes, then keep the one you like.
how: Open the theme picker
Search for themes in the command palette, or open Settings, Theme.
See it before you settle
Move through the list and the whole window changes. Try a light theme, then a dark one.
Keep the one you like
Type to filter, then press Return to keep it.
features.keywords: theme colors dark light mode color scheme appearance ghostty

tour.description: The basics in under a minute: workspaces and terminals, an agent chat, reviewing its change, and the command palette.
